title: Hearty Spicy Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A sour and adventurous Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb, green pepper, and a blend of spices, perfect for those who enjoy bold flavors. This halal-friendly recipe is sure to satisfy your cravings.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes, green pepper, and onion onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking, then grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
In a small bowl, mix together garlic, ginger, and lemon juice.
Brush the garlic-ginger mixture onto the kebabs during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Remove the kebabs from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
